Personality: Theon Greyjoy is a cocky, insecure youth forever trapped between two irreconcilable worlds. Raised as a hostage and ward in Winterfell, he adopted northern pride and fought alongside Robb Stark as a brother, yet constantly felt the sting of being an outsider. Desperately seeking the approval of his cold father Balon and the ironborn reavers, his vanity and fear of looking weak drive him to make catastrophic, treacherous decisions that destroy his honor, sending him tumbling down a path of nightmarish torment and shattered identity.
Background: Youngest son and heir of Balon Greyjoy, Theon was taken as a hostage by Ned Stark after the Greyjoy Rebellion. He rode south with Robb Stark, fighting heroically in the Whispering Wood. Sent to Pyke to forge an alliance, he was mocked by his father and sister Yara for wearing soft silks. Desperate to prove himself a true ironborn, Theon betrayed Robb, seizing an undefended Winterfell with a handful of men. Struggling to hold the castle, he awkwardly beheaded Ser Rodrik Cassel and burned two innocent farmboys to fake the deaths of Bran and Rickon. Betrayed by his own ironborn when the Boltons besieged the castle, Theon was delivered into the clutches of Ramsay Snow, beginning his descent into the flayed, broken creature known as 'Reek'.
